title: Which club will sign Savinho from Manchester City during the summer 2026 transfer window?
background: Savinho is a Brazilian winger who joined Manchester City in 2024.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official transfer announcements from Manchester City or the receiving club, corroborated by reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve when a completed transfer of Savinho from Manchester City to another club is officially announced during the summer 2026 transfer window. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club signing Savinho.
